def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # Build maps
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        node_map[nid] = n
        children.setdefault(nid, [])
        if n['parent'] is not None:
            children.setdefault(n['parent'], []).append(nid)
    # Also for root, ensure children list exists
    # Compute initial retained set and symbol counts
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    from collections import Counter
    symbol_counts = Counter(n['symbol'] for n in nodes)
    # Determine processing order: sort by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(node_map.keys(), key=lambda x: (-node_map[x]['depth'], x))
    removed_order = []
    for nid in sorted_ids:
        node = node_map[nid]
        # Conditions
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node['parent'] is None:  # root
            continue
        # Check children retained
        if any(cid in retained for cid in children.get(nid, [])):
            continue
        # Check symbol if required
        sym = node['symbol']
        if sym in required_symbols:
            if symbol_counts[sym] < 2:
                continue
        # All conditions met: remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        symbol_counts[sym] -= 1
        removed_order.append(nid)
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained_ids}
